sentences.text: Present:

The Hon'ble Justice Ananya Bandyopadhyay  FMAT(MV) 162 of 2024  Sukumar Biswas & Anr.
 -Vs-
The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.
For the Appellants/claimants : Mr. Jayanta Banerjee  Mr. Argha Bhattacharjee
For the respondent Nos. 1/insurance co. : Mr. Rajesh Singh
Heard on : 05.09.2024 Judgment on : 09.09.2024 Ananya Bandyopadhyay, J. :-
1. The Learned Advocates for the appellants/claimants as well as the respondent Nos. 1/insurance company are present.

2. The instant appeal has been filed against the judgment and order dated 18th October, 2023 passed by the Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Additional District Judge, 4th Court,
Krishnagar, Nadia in MAC Case No.554 of 2009 under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988.

entities.text:
Additional District Judge, 4th Court,
Krishnagar, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned tribunal has disposed of the issues framed and granted the compensation to the tune of Rs. 4,83,600/- along with default interest of 7.5 % p.a. per annum to be paid on the awarded amount till realization of the entire amount if the same was not paid within two months from the date of the order being 18.10.2023.

3. The application under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed before the Judge,
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Krishnagar, Nadia in MAC Case No.554 of 2009 on account of death of their son in an accident which occurred on 23rd November, 2008 at about 6.45 p.m. with the involvement of the offending vehicle being mini truck bearing registration No. WB-51/0972 whereby the victim succumbed to his injuries and being hit by the driver of the offending vehicle while the deceased was returning to his residence from Ranaghat Sukumar Biswas & Anr vs The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77750096/
1 by his bicycle through N.H.-34.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Krishnagar, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Ranaghat Sukumar Biswas & Anr vs The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The accident occurred near Begopara Telephone Exchange whereby the offending vehicle approached in a rash and negligent manner hit the deceased resulting in his death.

4. The Learned Advocate for the respondent No.1/insurance company did not dispute the occurrence of the accident nor the other ancillary issues including the involvement of the offending vehicle, validity of the driving licence and insurance policy etc.

5. Considering the judgment of the Hon'ble High Court in Urmila Halder v. The New India Assurance Company Ltd1. and the same being affirmed by the Supreme Court in Special Leave Petition2 and the notification dated 22nd May, 2018, the appellants/claimants are entitled to Rs.5,00,000/- towards just 2019(2)TAC 143 Special Leave Petition(Civil) No. 6260 of 2019 compensation with regard to second schedule 1(a) and notification dated 22nd May, 2018 and also the aforesaid observations of the High Court at Calcutta and the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

entities.text: Urmila Halder v. The New India Assurance Company Ltd1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The second schedule 1(a) is as follows: -
"Fatal Accidents:
Compensation payable in case of Death shall be five lakh rupees."
6. The impugned judgment passed by the aforesaid tribunal is modified to the extent of Rs. 16,400/-
(Rs.5,00,000-Rs. 4,83,600/-) along with interest to be paid at the rate of 6 % per annum from the date of filing of the application till the date of its actual realization.
7.
The Learned Advocate for the appellants/claimants submitted to have received the compensation of Rs. 4,83,600/-.

8. The Learned Advocate for the respondent Nos. 1/insurance company is to deposit the balance sum of Rs. 16,400/- along with 6 % per cent interest per annum from the date of filing of the claim application before the office of the Learned Registrar General, High Court Calcutta within six weeks from the date of passing of this order.

9. On receipt of the said amount, the office of the Registrar General, High Court, Calcutta shall encash the said cheque and thereafter disburse the same to the present appellants as mentioned in the award passed by the Judge, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal and Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Krishnagar, Nadia in MAC Case No.554 of 2009 on proof of proper identification of the appellants/claimants subject to payment of ad valorem Courts fees.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Krishnagar, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 10. The instant appeal is disposed of accordingly.
11. Copy of the order be sent to the Department as well as the concerned tribunal as expeditiously as possible.
